name: Building Services and Lifecycle Management
description: Concepts of functional design of building for fire protection, design of lift systems for optimum service, building service system design. Intelligent buildings systems and automation, HVAC systems (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning), hot and cold water services, waste water handling system, electrical services and power distribution, building maintenance management strategies, testing protocols and remedial maintenance, repair and retrofitting of buildings strategies, condition assessment and rehabilitation techniques.
